proposed.text: What is required when a required fire alarm system is out of service for more than four hours in a twenty-four-hour period?

options.text: Notify the C/MFM within twenty-four hours and assign fire watch until restored.
Ignore the condition if the building is occupied.
Replace the fire alarm with ordinary doorbells.

proposed.rationale: RA 9514 requires C/MFM notification within twenty-four hours and fire watch until the fire alarm system is returned to service.
proposed.explanation: RA 9514 requires C/MFM notification within twenty-four hours and fire watch until the fire alarm system is returned to service.
